Double-click a mod to give it your own name; Ctrl or Shift takes several at once, and the right button acts on all of them. Space shows a mod's cover and its options' pictures.

tip_no_purge:
In this mod manager, installing a mod never needs a purge first.

Install the mod, then click Deploy. Only what has changed is handled, usually in under half a second.

Restore vanilla only to play the game without mods; it is at the bottom of the card on the left.

The explaining lines in the window can be turned off in Settings.
purge_note: A deploy never needs a purge first. Restore vanilla only to play the game without mods.
synced: Deployed · the game folder matches the library
pending: To deploy: {0} new, {1} renamed, {2} deleted · writing {3}
lost: The mod library cannot be read. What was on show has been taken away: it is not the library as it is now. Trying again…

Delete “{0}” from the disk for good?

Its folder is deleted, not moved to the Recycle Bin:
{1}

It is also taken out of the library and out of the game (a deploy runs now). The archive it was added from is kept.

The one in use is deployed after every other mod; the others stay in the library and are not deployed, except Chef Shared Loader and MDL3 when they help Boot Mod Loader (see the compatibility below). Each card says which Lua mods would not start under that loader. A change applies at the next deploy.

set_profiles_note: On: the mod library holds every mod, and each profile some of them, with its own load order, on/off and options. The profile is chosen at the list's title. Off: one list; the profiles are kept.

set_keep_note: When a mod with Lua scripts gets a new version, the version it had is kept, and the mod's details can roll back to it. One version is kept for each mod; mods without scripts are not affected. The versions kept are listed on the Storage page.

report_note: One zip to send with a question: your mods and their order, the conflicts, the Lua checks, the deploy history, this manager's log, Boot Mod Loader's log, MDL3's native part and logs when MDL3 is installed, and the names of the game's crash dumps. Your Nexus Mods sign-in is never in it, and your Windows user folder is written as %USERPROFILE%.
report_done: Saved. A short summary is on the clipboard, to paste where a file cannot go.
